title: Animal viewing alert
preconditions: Console open. Species visible on map.

steps.name: Set alert
steps.do: Open **Set animal viewing alert**; species/exhibit, dates covering D, alert text.

steps.name: Submit alert
steps.expect: Success “… was given a viewing alert.”

steps.name: Map shows alert
steps.do: Map tooltip/banner for that animal on D.

steps.name: Map-only impact OK
steps.do: No itinerary required for Pass if map verified.
